finding: No trustworthy complete native lifecycle/generation/interval certificate can be established offline from the allowed public event source labels. This is not a universal impossibility theorem.

sources.supports: A foreign window may disappear or its handle may be reused after the check.
Registration/message-loop/bitness and reentrancy handling matter; event delivery order is not a certificate of full generation coverage.
ETW exposes event and buffer loss counters; zero does not independently prove emission completeness for this identity interval.

required_certificate: Independent trusted source identity and exact host/boot/session/desktop
Subscriptionready before begin,stable source epoch,no event or bufferloss
Monotonic loss-detectable sequence and outside prefix/finalhead ACK
Unforgeable generation bound to processcreation/windowidentity and complete interval

alternatives.option: Cooperating instrumented window owner and independent collector
alternatives.condition: Owner emits complete creation/destruction/generation stream with independent ACK; original human system dialog does not currently supply this contract

alternatives.option: Reviewed OS/kernel-level witness with attested provenance
alternatives.condition: Requires separate engineering,security review and realqualification; no undocumented hooks or driver deployment authorized
Do not turnbefore/afterHWND reads,WinEvent/ETWlabels or signatures into full lifecycleproof
